result.title: GeoNest: Learning to Select Failure-Aware Neighborhoods for the Irregular Knapsack Problem in a Circular Container
result.summary: The two-dimensional irregular knapsack problem in a fixed circular container is an important combinatorial optimization problem for maximizing material utilization in manufacturing. Conventional geometric packing solvers can produce tightly packed layouts, yet they often partition the residual space into isolated small pockets that cannot fit valuable unplaced polygons. To overcome this late-stage packing bottleneck, we propose a failure-aware large neighborhood search framework named GeoNest, driven by a graph policy trained via reinforcement learning. Specifically, we first construct neighborhoods by pairing failed target polygons with residual pockets. We then use explanatory poses to identify the placed polygons that block candidate insertions. These diagnosed blocking relations define bounded, fixed-item repair subproblems for the underlying geometric solver. Finally, the graph policy selects the most promising subproblem for execution. For evaluation, we introduce CircleNest-Bench, a benchmark comprising 2,391 load-controlled instances from four contour sources, including a held-out industrial CAD source. Experimental results demonstrate that, under the same total time budget, GeoNest improves mean utilization over a state-of-the-art standalone packing solver by about 0.9% on average across the three main test sets and by about 0.6% on the held-out industrial set.

AI.brief_summary: GeoNest 面向固定圆形二维不规则背包问题，用失败目标多边形与残差空洞配对构造修复子问题，再用 RL 训练的图策略选择最值得执行的修复子问题，并发布 CircleNest-Bench 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「失败感知 + 定位阻挡实体 + 选择修复子问题」的循环，可能与 LVR 中 LOOK（筛选视觉证据）、STOP（何时停止修补）及贡献分配有概念联系，可供核查，但属几何组合优化，迁移需较多验证。
